gates.gate_1: three-output target-blind P3 semantic parity smoke with telemetry integrity and runtime guard
gates.gate_2: full frozen Micro12 only after Gates 0 and 1 pass
gates.post_freeze: Gold labeling and analysis only after complete generation freeze, verification, compact evidence commit, and push

post_freeze_analysis.label: exact transformed-Gold token-prefix hash equality only

decision_rule: Recommend only PREREGISTER_P4_VALUE_GUIDED_SEARCH if preregistered same-frontier Top-1, MRR, task-bootstrap, and fold-stability criteria pass; never implement P4 here.
